item.title: In Praise of Stupid Questions
item.description:
📝 I want to focus on the species of question that I often tell students doesn’t exist: the Stupid Question. But I’m lying, or at least over-simplifying, when I tell my students that stupid questions don’t exist; the students (and you) all know that some questions are better than others. I still sometimes ask questions that don’t make literal sense.
🔗 Read more: https://mathenchant.wordpress.com/2026/03/12/in-praise-of-stupid-questions/
